source.version: Part 13 — Terpenes, Volatiles, and Other Secondary Metabolites — Batch 03
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-251–255 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 13 manuscript plus direct cannabis terpene-synthase/profile studies, comprehensive VSC and nonterpenoid aroma studies, cannabis anthocyanin/flavonoid work, multi-assay phenolic studies, trichome-development research, and phenological-stage volatile studies. Public wording rejects dominant-terpene-only aroma models, visible color as potency or maturity proof, antioxidant-assay values as health claims, and a universal peak-terpene flowering week.
source.note: This batch publishes minor-terpene interpretation, volatile sulfur compounds, flavonoids/pigments, phenolics/redox assay literacy, and aroma development across flower maturation.
